newsitem.title: UK: Both Brent cargoes turning wet kept - trade.
newsitem.headline: Both Brent cargoes turning wet kept - trade.

text.p: Both of the July 10-12 loading Brent blend crude cargoes turning wet on Wednesday were kept ahead of the five o'clock deadline, traders said.
One was kept by U.S. refiner and trader Koch, while the other was held onto by Stasco, they said.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
